require 'fileutils'

module DataIO
  def self.read_inputs
    rows = File.readlines('input/cases.csv', chomp: true).drop(1).map { |line| line.split(',').map(&:to_i) }
    groups, contacts = [], []
    File.foreach('input/population.txt') do |line|
      kind, *values = line.split
      if kind == 'group'
        groups << [values[0], values[1].to_i, values[2].to_f]
      else
        contacts << values.map(&:to_f)
      end
    end
    interventions = File.readlines('input/interventions.txt').map do |line|
      day, multiplier = line.split
      [day.to_i, multiplier.to_f]
    end
    params = { 'scenario' => [], 'contact_change' => [] }
    File.foreach('input/params.txt') do |line|
      name, *values = line.split
      params[name] = case name
                     when 'scenario'
                       params[name] << [values[0], values[1].to_f]
                     when 'contact_change'
                       params[name] << [values[0], values[1], values[2].to_f]
                     when 'holdout', 'death_lag', 'generation', 'horizon'
                       values[0].to_i
                     when 'milestones', 'golden'
                       values.map(&:to_i)
                     when 'beta_grid', 'rho_grid'
                       [values[0].to_f, values[1].to_f, values[2].to_i]
                     when 'nelder_mead'
                       [*values.take(4).map(&:to_f), values[4].to_i]
                     when 'initial', 'simplex'
                       values.map(&:to_f)
                     else
                       values[0].to_f
                     end
    end
    [rows.map { |r| r[1] }, rows.map { |r| r[2] }, groups, contacts, interventions, params]
  end

  def self.write_outputs(outputs)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p('output')
    outputs.each { |name, lines| File.write("output/#{name}", lines.join("\n") + "\n") }
  end
end

module Fitting
  PHI = 0.6180339887498949

  def self.golden(function, a, b, iterations)
    c = b - PHI * (b - a)
    d = a + PHI * (b - a)
    fc, fd = function.call(c), function.call(d)
    records = [[a, b, c, d, fc, fd]]
    iterations.times do
      if fc < fd
        b, d, fd = d, c, fc
        c = b - PHI * (b - a)
        fc = function.call(c)
      else
        a, c, fc = c, d, fd
        d = a + PHI * (b - a)
        fd = function.call(d)
      end
      records << [a, b, c, d, fc, fd]
    end
    fc < fd ? [c, fc, records] : [d, fd, records]
  end

  def self.nelder_mead(function, beta, gamma, db, dg, alpha, chi, psi, omega, iterations)
    vertices = [[beta, gamma], [beta + db, gamma], [beta, gamma + dg]].each_with_index.map do |point, number|
      [number, *point, function.call(*point)]
    end
    initial = vertices.dup
    serial = 3
    records = []
    order = ->(v) { [v[3], v[0]] }
    toward = ->(o, v, t) { 2.times.map { |axis| o[axis] + t * (v[axis] - o[axis]) } }
    iterations.times do
      vertices.sort_by!(&order)
      first, second, third = vertices
      centroid = [(first[1] + second[1]) / 2.0, (first[2] + second[2]) / 2.0]
      reflected = 2.times.map { |axis| centroid[axis] + alpha * (centroid[axis] - third[axis + 1]) }
      fr = function.call(*reflected)
      accepted = nil
      if fr < first[3]
        expanded = toward.call(centroid, reflected, chi)
        fe = function.call(*expanded)
        accepted, value, operation = fe < fr ? [expanded, fe, 'expand'] : [reflected, fr, 'reflect']
      elsif fr < second[3]
        accepted, value, operation = reflected, fr, 'reflect'
      elsif fr < third[3]
        contracted = toward.call(centroid, reflected, psi)
        fc = function.call(*contracted)
        accepted, value, operation = contracted, fc, 'contract_out' if fc <= fr
      else
        contracted = toward.call(centroid, third[1, 2], psi)
        fc = function.call(*contracted)
        accepted, value, operation = contracted, fc, 'contract_in' if fc < third[3]
      end
      if accepted
        vertices = [first, second, [serial, *accepted, value]]
        serial += 1
      else
        operation = 'shrink'
        vertices = [first]
        [second, third].each do |vertex|
          point = toward.call(first[1, 2], vertex[1, 2], omega)
          vertices << [serial, *point, function.call(*point)]
          serial += 1
        end
      end
      vertices.sort_by!(&order)
      records << [operation, vertices.first]
    end
    [initial, records, vertices]
  end
end

module Integrator
  def self.rk4_step(rates, state, multiplier)
    h = 0.25
    half, sixth = h / 2.0, h / 6.0
    k1 = rates.call(state, multiplier)
    k2 = rates.call(state.each_index.map { |i| state[i] + half * k1[i] }, multiplier)
    k3 = rates.call(state.each_index.map { |i| state[i] + half * k2[i] }, multiplier)
    k4 = rates.call(state.each_index.map { |i| state[i] + h * k3[i] }, multiplier)
    state.each_index.map { |i| state[i] + sixth * (((k1[i] + 2.0 * k2[i]) + 2.0 * k3[i]) + k4[i]) }
  end

  def self.simulate(rates, initial, multipliers, inflows)
    state = initial.dup
    multipliers.map do |multiplier|
      inflows.each { |i| state[i] = 0.0 }
      4.times { state = rk4_step(rates, state, multiplier) }
      state.dup
    end
  end
end

module Models
  def self.seird(population, sigma, fatality, beta, gamma)
    lambda do |state, multiplier|
      s, e, i = state
      flow = beta * multiplier * s * i / population
      progression = sigma * e
      removal = gamma * i
      [-flow, flow - progression, progression - removal,
       (1.0 - fatality) * gamma * i, fatality * gamma * i, progression]
    end
  end

  def self.sir(population, beta, gamma)
    lambda do |state, multiplier|
      s, i = state
      flow = beta * multiplier * s * i / population
      removal = gamma * i
      [-flow, flow - removal, removal, flow]
    end
  end

  def self.age_seird(populations, fatalities, sigma, beta, gamma, contacts)
    lambda do |state, multiplier|
      populations.each_index.flat_map do |g|
        s, e, i = state[6 * g, 3]
        pressure = 0.0
        populations.each_index { |h| pressure += contacts[g][h] * state[6 * h + 2] / populations[h] }
        force = beta * multiplier * pressure
        flow = force * s
        progression = sigma * e
        removal = gamma * i
        [-flow, flow - progression, progression - removal,
         (1.0 - fatalities[g]) * gamma * i, fatalities[g] * gamma * i, progression]
      end
    end
  end

  def self.generation(sigma, gamma)
    lambda do |state, _multiplier|
      e, i = state
      progression = sigma * e
      removal = gamma * i
      [-progression, progression - removal, removal]
    end
  end
end

module Report
  def fmt(value, places = 4)
    text = format("%.#{places}f", value)
    text.match?(/\A-0(?:\.0+)?\z/) ? text.delete_prefix('-') : text
  end

  def curve_plot(observed, fitted)
    days, maximum = observed.length, observed.max
    width = maximum.to_s.length
    grid = Array.new(20) { Array.new(70, '.') }
    70.times do |column|
      day = column * (days - 1) / 69
      ro = [19, 20 * observed[day] / maximum].min
      rf = [19, (20.0 * fitted[day] / maximum).floor].min
      grid[ro][column] = 'o'
      grid[rf][column] = ro == rf ? '#' : '*'
    end
    lines = ["plot observed o fitted * both # days 1 #{days} max #{maximum}"]
    19.downto(0) { |row| lines << "#{(maximum * row / 20).to_s.rjust(width)} |#{grid[row].join}" }
    lines << ' ' * (width + 1) + '+' + 70.times.map { |x| x % 10 == 0 ? '+' : '-' }.join
    labels = ' ' * 70
    (0...70).step(10) do |column|
      label = (1 + column * (days - 1) / 69).to_s
      labels[column, label.length] = label
    end
    lines << (' ' * (width + 2) + labels).rstrip
    lines
  end
end
